articles.title: Infineon (XTRA:IFX) Stock May Be 14% Undervalued Following AI Data Center Power News
articles.summary: Infineon Technologies has delivered a 60.5% gain over the past three years, yet recent share price swings put the spotlight squarely on a different issue: whether today's valuation is supported by the cash flows the business can generate. After a sharp pullback in recent weeks and fresh headlines around power solutions for AI data centers, the question for investors is how much of the current price can be explained by the cash that might eventually flow back to shareholders.
